decisions.reason: Its visibility increased from a mention to a dedicated page and it fits the core modular sensing platform, so results likely meet aspirations well enough to justify retention.
It remained on its own page with fresh launch emphasis in 2024 and strongly leverages the established industrial I/O architecture, indicating performance above the threshold for continued support.

It is close to the existing automation offer and likely inexpensive to carry within the modular portfolio, but its limited website prominence suggests somewhat weaker results and a higher risk if aspirations are missed.

As a 2024 extension of the established control ecosystem it is still in an uncertainty period, and with organisational slack the firm would usually allow more time before dropping it unless early uptake is clearly poor.

Although new, it supports the firm’s stated move toward networked charging and energy management, so its strategic complementarity lowers the chance of removal despite still-uncertain standalone results.
